description: Generates a lawnmower survey mission (waypoints + timing) over a traced farm boundary, for image or video capture, via the generate-scouting-mission Tapis app (jobs/scouting_mission_generator). Produces .waypoints/.plan/.kmz/.json mission files plus a next_steps.txt with the exact local command to actually fly the mission and upload captured media — flying requires the drone's own local Wi-Fi network, so it always runs outside the platform, via the standalone executable built from fly_mission.py (see that folder's README).

inputs.name: gpkg
inputs.description: Optional — if wired, its farm_boundary layer is shown on the map as a reference overlay while tracing the scouting boundary. Not otherwise used by this step.

boundary_points.description: Farm boundary traced on the map, as 'lat,lon;lat,lon;...' (3+ points, internal — set by clicking the map, not typed directly).

home_lat.description: Latitude of the approximate starting point — used for takeoff/RTL and to orient the scan pattern.

home_lon.description: Longitude of the approximate starting point.

altitude_m.description: Flight altitude in meters, relative to takeoff.

line_spacing_m.description: Distance in meters between parallel lawnmower survey lines. Tighter spacing gives denser coverage but a longer flight.

capture_mode.description: 'image' stops and captures a still every 'Image capture distance'. 'video' records continuously through the whole mission with no stops.

capture_spacing_m.description: Image mode only: distance in meters between successive still-image captures along each survey line.

hold_time_s.description: Image mode only: seconds to hover at each capture stop before taking the photo.

image_upload_path.description: Where captured images/video should be uploaded after the flight — a Tapis system + directory. Not used by this generation job itself; carried through into the generated next_steps.txt so the local flight command is pre-filled.

tapis_job.name: scouting-mission
tapis_job.description: Generate a lawnmower scouting-mission survey over a traced farm boundary
